title: Paraphrase and lexical cohesion
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply paraphrase and lexical cohesion in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 追踪不同词组如何指向同一概念，同时保留概念之间的差别。
grammar: cohesion 包括指代、同义改写、上义词与重复关键词。this intervention 可以回指前句措施；不是所有同主题词都指同一对象。先标注名词链，再解释连贯关系。
common_mistake: shelter 与 housing 可能相关，但在具体文本中不一定可以无损互换。

reading: The council offered grants for insulation in older homes. This intervention was intended to reduce winter heating demand. Owners of eligible dwellings could apply for help with roof and wall improvements. The retrofit programme did not cover every type of building work. In particular, decorative repairs remained the owner's responsibility. These limits matter when comparing the scheme with broader housing subsidies. Both support households, but they fund different activities and should not be treated as identical policies.
listening_script: The council offered grants for insulation in older homes. This intervention was intended to reduce winter heating demand. Owners of eligible dwellings could apply for help with roof and wall improvements. The retrofit programme did not cover every type of building work. In particular, decorative repairs remained the owner's responsibility. These limits matter when comparing the scheme with broader housing subsidies. Both support households, but they fund different activities and should not be treated as identical policies.
